note: P3830 (Pro 6:31) — but if caught, he will pay sevenfold; give all the goods of his house.

dims.v: restitution — the thief can at least repay sevenfold
the restitution the thief makes, repaying sevenfold from all his house
(the theft that can be made good)
the reparability of theft set against the adulterer's irreparable ruin

shalam (repay/make whole/restore) — the thief, though caught, CAN make restitution; theft is reparable. The read sets this against 6:32-33: adultery admits no such making-good. Restitution as a moral capacity theft leaves intact.
